facts.text: Winnie, they put pumpkin in the coffee here. Pumpkin, in coffee. Sit down before I eat the lot.
facts.why: Not a line in the Wikiquote page, and no pumpkin spice latte scene appears in the plot or the review pages read. It looks invented.
facts.fix: Winnie, I can smell children all over Salem tonight. Sit down before I eat the lot.

facts.text: Winnie still can't believe it's coffee.
facts.why: No coffee or latte scene in the transcript or plot. The transcript does have the sisters mixing up lotions and potions, so the line uses that.
facts.fix: Winnie still thinks lotions are potions.

facts.text: the sisters' cauldron bubbling away in the old cottage
facts.why: The sisters say they will fly to their ancestral cottage to get Book and brew their potion, and Wikipedia says that cottage is now Gilbert's magic shop. A bubbling cauldron there is not shown, so the note says only brewing.
facts.fix: the sisters brewing at their old cottage, now Gilbert's shop
